datasets.name: DepositAccno
datasets.sql:
select ac.id,ac.acc_no,av.VAL_NAME from account ac,
                                  sbcm_categories_new sc,
                                  sbcm_movie_names_new sm,
                                  sbcm_settings_new ss,
                                  sbcm_contracts_new sb,
                                  avalute av where 
 
sb.ID        =:ContractID             and
ss.CURRENCYID=sb.CURRENCY             and
sc.id        =sm.TYPEID               and
sm.NAME      ='outComeAccForDeposit'  and
sm.id        =ss.PARENTID             and
ac.id        =ss.ACCID                and
ac.VAL_ACC   =av.VALUTE               and
sc.id        =sb.CLIENTTYPE

datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select 
       dm_stored_programs.GetCustomerName(customerid) as name ,
       dm_stored_programs.GetOpenDate(ID) as opendate,
       dm_stored_programs.GetCloseDate(ID) as closedate,
       dm_stored_programs.GetProlongationDate(ID) as prolongationdate,
       dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccNo(ID) as ContractAccNo,
       dm_stored_programs.GetClientAccNo(ID)   as ClientAccNo,
       dm_stored_programs.GetInterestAccNo(ID) as InterestAccNo,
       dm_stored_programs.GetFacticalDebt(ID) as FacticalDebt,
       dm_stored_programs.GetFacticalInterestDebt(ID) as FacticalInterestDebt,
       dm_stored_programs.GetClientFacticalDebt(dm_stored_programs.GetClientAccid(ID)) as ostat,
       dm_stored_programs.GetBefointRatePercent(ID) as ANNUALINT
from 
  dm_contracts 
where 
  type#=3 
 and
  ID = :ContractID
